scrim.$description: black at 60%: a dark page is already near-black, so 40% would barely dim it; 60% keeps the modal separated from what is behind it.

on-info-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted info surface. Dark: the same step as `info`, which already clears AA on the dark tint (7.70:1 over the page) because a 10% tint lightens a dark surface away from light text.

on-success-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted success surface. Dark: one step lighter than `success`, which measures 4.4982:1 on its own 15% tint over `muted` — at the AA threshold rather than clearly over it. This is 6.03:1 at the same worst case.

on-warning-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted warning surface. Dark: the same step as `warning`, which already clears AA on the dark tint (7.38:1 at its worst case) because a tint lightens a dark surface away from light text.

on-destructive-container.$description: text and icons on a tinted error surface. Dark: one step lighter than `destructive`, which is 4.28:1 on its own 10% tint over `muted` and fails AA. This is 6.38:1 at the same worst case.

on-info-container.$description: text on a tinted info surface (bg-info/10). Dark: same as --info, which already clears AA on the dark tint. Light counterpart is darker — see color.light.json.

muted-on-container.$description: secondary text on a tinted container. Dark: identical to --muted-foreground, which already clears AA on every dark tint (6.92:1 on bg-primary/10 over --card, 7.24:1 on bg-destructive/10). Darkening is a light-mode problem only, because a 10% tint lightens a dark surface away from the text rather than toward it. Light counterpart is darker — see color.light.json.

action.$description: the interactive colour (buttons, selected controls). Defaults to `primary`; override `--action` on its own to split the interactive colour from `primary`.

action-hover.$description: Kinetic Weave action at 90% over background; mirrors web alpha state.

action-pressed.$description: Kinetic Weave action at 85% over background; mirrors web alpha state.

focus.$description: focus indicator colour. Defaults to `ring`; override `--focus` to theme focus separately.

link.$description: inline link / Link-button text colour. Defaults to `primary`.
